overview_description.description: Keyframe Labs builds human foundation models. Its first family of models powers lifelike avatars that interact with users in real time, enabling AI agents and applications to go beyond text and voice with just a few lines of code. Keyframe’s proprietary tech combines state-of-the-art realism with ultra-low latency at scale.
